info.title: nodejs-hw
info.description: Express notes API with cookie-based sessions, user avatars and email password resets. Generated request schemas come directly from the Celebrate/Joi schemas. Unknown routes return 404 {message: "Route not found"} after preceding middleware; unauthenticated requests reaching the unscoped notes router instead return 401.

servers.description: Local server (default PORT=3000). Change this URL if PORT is overridden.

sessionId.name: sessionId
sessionId.description: HttpOnly session identifier set by register, login and refresh.

accessToken.name: accessToken
accessToken.description: HttpOnly opaque UUID access token, valid for 15 minutes. Required together with sessionId.

refreshToken.name: refreshToken
refreshToken.description: HttpOnly opaque UUID refresh token, valid for one day. Required together with sessionId for refresh.

noteId.description: MongoDB ObjectId validated by mongoose.isValidObjectId. The Joi field itself is optional; OpenAPI path parameters are always required.
